component.name: Termsie
component.summary: One window for everything you're running

description.p: A native terminal for developers who always have five things going at once. Terminals float in one window, each tagged with an environment that colours it, with a list down the side showing every terminal, what it is doing and a live picture of its screen.
Each terminal keeps its own command history and its own startup commands, closed terminals keep their output, and a whole window of terminals saves as a workspace.
